It took me way longer than i expected to get used to its own speed changes and fast-paced click patterns mostly but the level was so much fun at the same time so i had kinda good time with it... i love this level so much
In terms of the difficulty, still underrated. should be above the golden and be early top 60's at least although i actually put less attempts than what i did on zodiac before.
If you guys even ask me to rebeat it for some reason, i'd say NO. it was literally my LUCKIEST MOMENT in my entire gd career.

tbh லெவலில் எனக்கு கொஞ்சம் மோசமான அனுபவங்கள் இருந்ததாக நினைக்கிறேன், முதலில் 2-3 ஸ்ட்ரீம்கள் மட்டுமே தேவைப்படும் என்று நினைத்தேன், உண்மையில் HOLY SHIT 4 நாட்கள் துன்பப்பட வேண்டியிருந்தது. ப்ரீட்ராப் போட்டியுடன் நான் மிகவும் போராடினேன், அது என்னை மிகவும் எரிச்சலூட்டியது, அதனால் நான் லைவ் ஸ்ட்ரீமில் டிராப் வரை கூட வரவில்லை, இது ஒரு முழுமையான வலி, இது லெவலை முற்றிலும் சலிப்பாக்குகிறது.

snippet.title: (EXTREME DEMON) "IH8" 100% VERIFIED! - Ence and more | Geometry Dash 2.2
snippet.description:
My First 2.2 Verification is here: A BLUE MUSHROOM AHH AHH
"I love how this is actually his first ever created level."

10/10 Deco, have literally no words what to say in terms of decorations. I'd just say that send mad respect to all the creators, they all smashed it :D
Basically it was supposed to be an insane demon at first and i asked them to make a buffdate and that would be a good beginner extreme for sure. After that, they really did! i never thought they would really work on that
However, i had trouble with the broken balancing and random bugs that i was never aware of. and I HATE too see someone saying it's like, "Oh is that a dorami verification? that's why the level sucks." so i put almost every attempt for only bugfixing and playtesting mostly to make it better and better and better right after i got a copy although i heard that they already did playtesting it before. Thankfully it turned out really good imo so i proudly say it's gonna be a pretty good consideration to be people's first extreme :D
Now i just can't imagine how much better their next level is gonna be...

snippet.title: [MY SECOND HARDEST] TERMINAL RAMPANCY 100% (TOP 70) - WR FLUKE🏆 | Geometry Dash 2.2
snippet.description:
NO WORDS, NO EXPECTATION, NO CARE

This was simply my CRAZIEST FLUKE I've ever had... on my "SECOND HARDEST" WTF LOL
Idk how tf i made this, i was aware of the fact that the second half was so brutal and way more inconsistent to do from the beginning than other mainlist ones so i thought i might make a tons of stupid dumb deaths past 50% at first and yessssss, THIS IS RANDOMLY HAPPENED...
Also It's just been about a week since i started practicing the level and i had only 3 grinding streams after making a few w runs off-stream and that's it.

I'd say it's a physical mostly-based gameplay so i put nearly 70% of my attempts for the practice ONLY. It took me way longer than i expected to get used to its own speed changes and fast-paced click patterns mostly but the level was so much fun at the same time so i had kinda good time with it... i love this level so much
In terms of the difficulty, still underrated. should be above the golden and be early top 60's at least although i actually put less attempts than what i did on zodiac before.
If you guys even ask me to rebeat it for some reason, i'd say NO. it was literally my LUCKIEST MOMENT in my entire gd career.
THANK YOU TERMINAL RAMPANCY MY LOVE, An absolutely phenomenal level, best mainlist in the game!
